reference.title: Ultimate Limit State Design of Steel-Plated Structures
reference.series_note: stiffened-panel uniaxial compression collapse tests reported in the book

how_to_use: Fill 'specimens' with the three test entries, each with provenance text naming the page/table and primary_source_verified = true only after the primary table has been consulted.
The output carries evidence_grade = WITHHELD while any specimen is unverified, so an unverified transcription can never be promoted to REAL by accident.
synthetic_fixture_note: tests/test_smith_progressive_collapse.py exercises the harness with SYNTHETIC fixtures (measured value = model value, then scaled by 0.9/1.1) to prove the loader, the deviation arithmetic and the grade propagation. Synthetic fixtures are labelled as such and are never reported as experimental evidence.
